title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management: Triage Agent user risk and activity pattern summaries
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, agent controls, licensing, included capacity and username privacy exception are supported. Minor corrections should clarify Microsoft's differing identity descriptions, finish the trigger-control instructions and remove a capacity checklist item without a matching control row.
